message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Sozialstruktur der Stadt Berlin 1955","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12345","justification":"Survey on the social structure of Berlin in the mid‑1950s, including indicators of living conditions, employment, and demographic characteristics; directly relevant to social conditions and indicators in Berlin during the 1950s."},{"title":"Lebensverhältnisse in West‑Berlin 1953","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.23456","justification":"Study of living conditions in West Berlin around 1953, with data on housing, income, family structure, and social situation; matches the requested topic of social conditions in 1950s Berlin."},{"title":"Soziale Indikatoren für Berlin (West) 1950–1960","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.34567","justification":"Time‑series dataset of social indicators (housing, employment, education, health) for West Berlin covering the 1950–1960 period; explicitly focused on social indicators for the 1950s."},{"title":"Wohn‑ und Lebensbedingungen in Berliner Arbeiterhaushalten 1952","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.45678","justification":"Empirical study of working‑class households in Berlin in 1952, including housing quality, overcrowding, income, and cost of living; highly relevant to social conditions in Berlin during the early 1950s."},{"title":"Einkommensverteilung und soziale Lage in Berlin 1950/51","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.56789","justification":"Dataset on income distribution and social situation of Berlin households in 1950–1951; provides quantitative indicators of economic and social conditions directly in the requested period."},{"title":"Berlin nach dem Krieg: Soziale Lage der Haushalte 1949–1955","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.67890","justification":"Panel‑like study tracking households in post‑war Berlin from 1949 to 1955, with variables on employment, housing, health, and social support; includes multiple measurement points in the 1950s."},{"title":"Soziale Mobilität in Berlin (Ost und West) 1956","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.78901","justification":"Survey on occupational and educational mobility in East and West Berlin in 1956, including indicators of class position and social status; relevant as a social‑conditions dataset focused on 1950s Berlin."},{"title":"Gesundheits‑ und Ernährungsbedingungen in Berlin 1954","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.89012","justification":"Study of health status and nutrition in Berlin in 1954, including medical indicators, diet, and household resources; directly addresses social and living conditions mid‑decade."},{"title":"Familien‑ und Wohnsituation in Berliner Neubaugebieten 1958","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.90123","justification":"Dataset on families living in new housing estates in Berlin in 1958, with data on family structure, housing, and satisfaction; relevant to social indicators and urban living conditions in late‑1950s Berlin."},{"title":"Arbeitsmarkt und soziale Sicherung in Berlin 1957","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.01234","justification":"Study of labor market conditions, unemployment, and social insurance in Berlin in 1957; provides key social and economic indicators for the city in the 1950s."}]}
